export_identifiers.genbank_definition: Yash Design 4 MAIN16 known DNA segment before unspecified PolyA; partial research construct

post_poly_a_extension.policy: Any extension after PolyA depends on its architecture; no downstream bases or template boundary are assigned.

constraints: Preserve exact translation of the full selected protein and every component.
Freeze the known leader, three stops, 3-prime UTR and upstream DNA context; leave PolyA and downstream extension unspecified.
Exclude configured motifs and codons below the frequency cutoff within the coding sequence.
No XbaI site in the known upstream DNA template.
optimization.heuristic_scope: Bracket-run reduction and alternative-frame-stop placement are sequential heuristics; no global optimality or expression guarantee is claimed.
implementation_changes: Corrected motif checks and bounded repair, input/output handling, immutable codon exclusions, codon-level pairing classes and repeat-window bounds.
Recorded seed and pinned ViennaRNA Python API with cached folds; retained the original sequential heuristics.
Removed unused flanking-sequence presets; the builder attaches the recorded fixed backbone independently.
Added post-repeat 1-fold-per-step structure repair to retain longest paired-bracket run <= 14 nt with zero repeated 12-nt words.
Independently enumerate and freeze every alternative-frame stop nucleotide after stop insertion.
Record every bounded initiation-accessibility trial and verify all protected nucleotides after refinement.
Removed an unreachable duplicate match branch and try later synonymous first-codon choices when earlier stop-insertion candidates fail motif checks.
optimization.method: Source PopRNA heuristics, complete alternative-frame-stop nucleotide protection, then bounded full-known-segment ensemble initiation-accessibility refinement.
not_optimized: Protein order/linkers (fixed by upstream joint optimization)

reference_only.scope: Downstream DNA context from the original example, retained for provenance only. It is not assigned to this design or included in its sequence exports.

source.PolyA_policy: PolyA and any downstream extension are intentionally unspecified; only the known upstream segment is exported.
source.dna_source: DNA pasted by the user in this chat, 2026-10-31
source.utr_names: Fibalpha and HBA1 labels inherited from the spreadsheet; sequence identities are pinned to PL3092.

template_context.topology: unspecified; export the known upstream DNA context without asserting a complete circular plasmid or downstream endpoint
